title: Home robot
summary: A general-purpose robot that helps around the house.
whyItFails: Technical difficulty. Homes are unstructured. Cost. Robots are expensive. Limited usefulness. Early robots do little.
whatWouldChange: Advances in foundation models for robotics and cheaper actuators.

attempts.notes: Consumer robots including Cozmo and Vector; shut down May 2019.
Marketed as the first family robot; failed to raise further funding.

reasons.detail: Limited usefulness: Early robots do little.
